title: Route Exception Report
subtitle: Route Exception: preserves facts, evidence, and actions.
description: Route Exception Report covers route event, vehicle, stop, shipment, delay, safety condition, and recovery plan. The dispatch exception coordinator records Route Exception chronology, evidence, containment, and effectiveness. Route Exception Report keeps Route Exception exceptions visible until the dispatch exception coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Route Exception Report at current safe location, planned route, affected stop, alternate route, and return point. Document route event, vehicle, stop, shipment, delay, safety condition, and recovery plan identity before Route Exception begins. Compare route event, vehicle, stop, shipment, delay, safety condition, and recovery plan findings with stated Route Exception criteria; route unresolved Route Exception issues to transport operations reviewer. For Route Exception Report, confirm requirements for Route Exception. Ask transport operations reviewer to review Route Exception conditions beyond the dispatch exception coordinator's role.

items: Exception type and immediate safety state

blocks.guidance: Record what was checked without converting an allegation, inference, or unavailable fact into an observation.

blocks.label: Severity, notification, and escalation triggers
blocks.guidance: Pause Route Exception and notify dispatch exception coordinator when safe location, driver fitness, vehicle condition, cargo custody, or authorized recovery remains unresolved.

sections.title: Corrective action, disposition, and review
sections.guidance: Track containment through disposition and an effectiveness check; do not close an incident merely because the immediate event stopped.
